valor: Laura, an introverted thirteen-year-old, arrives in a town surrounded by palm plantations and an imposing forest. As she adjusts to her new family, she glimpses a hidden world where a story circulates about a forest beast that feeds on women. She dismisses it as a childish fantasy, but her friendship with magnetic Daniela takes her on a journey.
